text:
Priya: Brightbeam asked if we can formalize a 'migration bridge' for mid-rollouts so they don't have to emergency-pin for 3 months. They want a clear timeline + credits. Can we scope a product lane? cc @Diego @Hannah
Diego: What's their current pin and traffic profile? need to know async before committing discounts.
Priya: They're pinned to rwd-7b-quant, ~55 QPS, heavy reads from na-west and a handful of high-cost rerank flows. Our quick canary flagged a 4.5% semantic delta and a small embedding drift in recall@5.
Hannah: 4.5% is borderline; we usually allow <=3% for tier-1 customers. Curious if the delta is concentrated on long-tail prompts. Can ops produce per-segment diffs?
Ethan: Ops can run a segmented diag. Proposal from my side: a 2-week bridge for urgent runs, then a longer 30/60-day runway for phased cutovers. Bridge = no SLA change, 0% credit. Runway tiers = 30/60 days with optional credits of 10%/18% respectively.
Priya: Customer indicated they'd accept 30d with 10% but asked for guaranteed weekly status and one-click rollback.
Diego: We should make a checklist gate before any runway bump. Draft checklist below:
```text
- run golden prompts (customer-specific) and compare semantic pass rate
- embedding recall@5 and median cosine delta
- tail perf test (p95 across regions)
- synthetic cold-start/kv-warm simulation
- structured-output schema smoke
- failover variant sanity check
```
Hannah: Add: data-privacy signoff for private deployments, and contract language that captures credit accounting and exit criteria.
Ethan: Also recommend instrumenting a migration metric: weeks_on_runway + weekly_delta_trend to detect regressions or improvements. Use that to auto-suggest extension or rollback.
finance-bot: Reminder: discounts >15% need finance approval. Route request via /approve-discount.
Priya: Action items: (1) Diego + Ethan to produce per-segment diag and draft checklist automation, (2) Hannah to draft contract snippet for runway credits, (3) Priya to own customer comms template. Target: internal draft in 3 business days.
Diego: I'll post the segmented diffs by tomorrow morning.
Hannah: I'll pull the legal template and coordinate with finance if >15% required.
Ethan: I'll prototype the weekly trend metric and a simple webhook that can trigger rollback.
Priya: Thanks all 
We'll review in product sync Tuesday. Keep updates short so CS can forward to Brightbeam. :white_check_mark:
